files.shelter_registry.csv: facility_id, facility_name, address, capacity, opened_local, closed_local, evacuation_zones_served, pets, medical_station, operator
files.shelter_daily_census.csv: end-of-day count per shelter: date_local, facility_id, facility_name, capacity, occupancy, new_arrivals, departures, spanish_speaking_pct, english_speaking_pct, staff_on_duty, bilingual_staff_on_duty, status
files.shelter_211_calls.csv: 2-1-1 shelter calls: date_local, call_time_local, call_id, caller_evacuation_zone, topic, language, referred_facility_id, note
files.evacuation_bus_trips.csv: county evacuation bus trips: pickup_local, unit_id, pickup_area, facility_id, arrival_local, passengers
files.shelter_intake_log.csv: front-desk arrivals: arrival_local, facility_id, facility_name, persons, arrival_mode (EVACUATION BUS, PRIVATE VEHICLE, WALK-IN, RESCUE BOAT, HIGH-WATER VEHICLE, ESCORTED ON FOOT, BUS FROM NAS CORPUS CHRISTI), reference (bus unit id or rescue mission id). new_arrivals in the census is the day's sum of persons.

notes: Occupancy and staffing figures are scenario values. Times are local.

joins.to: sar/sar_missions.csv mission_id, or cad_units.json unit_id for buses

generator_reference: What the data must show, and when, is in 00_scenario/canon_timeline.json (internal). This schema describes format and joins only. Generators: scripts/streams/gen_ground.py and gen_ground_public.py; checks: scripts/check_streams.py, scripts/check_geo.py.
